description: Technical-indicator computation (SMA, EMA, RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, plus the ensemble state) on bars you supply — no external data fetch. Computed data, not a recommendation. Paid via x402 ($0.01 USDC on Base) when a payer wallet is configured; otherwise returns the payment requirements.

bars.description: OHLCV bars (10–5000); each needs at least a close

date.description: Bar date (any label; defaults to the bar index)

series.description: Also return the full indicator series, not just the latest values

name: trading_indicators
